name: Red Shambhala
overview: Young investigator Klim Shumny gets his hands on an unusual case. Strange clues, coincidences and people who clearly do not fit into the laws of modern science drag Klim into a story related to a large-scale experiment of the Soviet era. The deeper he delves into what is happening, the more obvious it becomes: this is not just about a crime, but about a mystery that can change the image of a person and his capabilities.
